title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
text:
MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Agreement is between Northstar Robotics Ltd and Harbor Labs Inc, effective 1 April 2025.

1. Purpose
The parties may exchange confidential technical and commercial information solely to assess a possible joint robotics project. Neither party is required to proceed with a transaction.

2. Confidential Information
Confidential Information includes marked documents and information reasonably understood to be confidential. Public information, information independently developed, and information lawfully received from a third party are excluded.

3. Use and Disclosure
Each recipient may use Confidential Information only for the Purpose and disclose it to employees and advisers who need to know and are bound by equivalent duties. A recipient may disclose information required by law after giving notice where legally permitted.

4. Additional Permitted Disclosures
Harbor Labs may disclose Northstar's customer lists and prototype specifications to any prospective customer without Northstar's consent, despite the other restrictions in this Agreement.

5. Duration
Northstar's confidentiality duties survive for ten years after termination. Harbor Labs' confidentiality duties end immediately on termination, including for trade secrets received from Northstar.

6. Return of Materials
Within 15 days of a written request, each party will return or securely delete the other's Confidential Information, except one archival copy required by law.

7. Liability
Northstar must indemnify Harbor Labs for all losses arising from any disclosure, including Harbor Labs' own negligence. Harbor Labs has no liability for its own unauthorized disclosure.

8. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales. The courts of London have exclusive jurisdiction.
